# Chars: 左阿=Zuo'a, 溪月/冰溪月=Xiyue/Bing Xiyue, 蓝柒=Lanqi, 纱雪=Shaxue, 石风雄=Shi Fengxiong,
#  枫杏红=Feng Xinghong, 心魔之主=Lord of Inner Demons, 喵咕啦=Meowgula, 混元门=Hunyuan Sect.

column2:
[Xiyue] You've now earned the right to receive the inheritance! Next, let me take you to see the master. How much insight-XP and cultivation wisdom you gain in the Inheritance Illusion is up to you.

[Neko] I… can't accept this.
[Nanami] …Koko, let's follow along.
No, that's not what I mean…

[Neko] The sum of 100,000 to 3.1 billion Sky-Tier Rank 1s! If we could cultivate some Skyhigh-Tier powerhouses, surely a steady stream of Treasure Coins and Cosmic Coins would come pouring in… Once I've received the inheritance, it's time to consolidate the family! The me of now feels I've already got what it takes to challenge Father. (You Sky-Tier Peak [-4] old thing! Your era is over!)
(gives herself a shake) Let me pull myself together…

[???] Little girl, to have come this far — commendable courage, commendable nerve.
[Zuo'a] First, let me introduce myself. Formerly of the Yangang Fief's Hunyuan Sect, its junior sect-master, Zuo'a.
[Nanami] Zuo'a?! You're… that senior recorded in the Yangang Fief's histories?
[Zuo'a] Haha, correct. After all these years, a junior still remembers my name — seems the world hasn't forgotten me entirely.
(Sister… I've never read the histories. Who is he?)

[Nanami] A senior master from about a hundred thousand years ago… whose conflict with the sect-master destroyed the once-flourishing 【Hunyuan Sect】.
[Zuo'a] Heh, whispering here can't hide from my senses. Back then, I came from an outer-disciple household, of plain talent and little regard. Later, I awakened an innate Primordial-Spirit Body, and only then surged ahead to become a sect elder.

[Neko] Huh? How can an innate Primordial-Spirit Body be awakened later in life?
[Zuo'a] Ahem… in any case, the sect-master wanted to seize my body! As a Skyhigh-Tier Peak, I took him down with me. But in the instant of my death, I stepped into the Domain-Tier.

[Zuo'a] And so I ended up like this, living in this barrier in a twisted form. Since you braved great risk to come here and passed the many trials I set, I naturally can't let you leave empty-handed.
[Zuo'a] Now, open your bodies and minds, enter the Inheritance Illusion, and receive my inheritance. I only send you into the illusion; how much insight you gain depends on your fortune. Remember, the inheritance is given only to the fated… I've hogged Xiyue's dialogue box long enough — time for me to rest.

As Zuo'a's voice fell, white light welled up before Neko and Nanami's eyes, as if to drag the souls from their bodies. The white light lasted a moment, and then, at the center of this space, a great vortex formed.

Faintly, colored radiance was reflected within the vortex. As the light inside grew brighter and brighter, Neko could finally see everything around her, and slowly opened her eyes.

Entering the Inheritance Illusion — Nanami… never mind, we won't take this one. You've probably got a Heart of the Ice Field by now anyway…

[Neko] Just as I thought, these crystals hold Senior Zuo'a's insights! Such powerful force… yet laced with a strong, violent aura. Senior Zuo'a, what did you go through in the past? I must calm my mind and focus… never mind, it's not my place to judge him.

[Neko] …With just a light touch, many parts of the Technique I hadn't yet fully grasped suddenly became clear. This is the Technique Brother Feng gave me; its true potential really is extraordinary. (inner monologue: after all, the cap is level 50!) I'm a little excited — I wonder how strong it'll be once the transformation succeeds?

Comprehended a new Technique 【Starmirror Violet】! Please equip it in the equipment slot.
And the Sister in the Crypt… is she really Sister?
Huh, Sister… what did you say?

[Nanami] Koko! You're finally awake! You were fighting the Crypt monsters and used up too much stamina, so you fainted. But don't worry — Sister just cleared out all the monsters in this area. Sister will protect you.
Sister, just now when I fainted—

[Neko] you were… clearing the monsters in this area, right?

[Nanami?] That's right, so don't worry. With Sister here, these are all small problems…
You… you're not Sister!

[Neko] Before entering the illusion, Sister was only Sky-Tier Rank 6! There's no way she could beat Rank 8-9 enemies.

[Nanami?] ……………

[Neko] Are you listening? I finally understand — everything I'm seeing now is an illusion, not some kind of time reversal. Just who are you?
Just who are you?

[Neko] You're the Inner Demon in my heart! Aren't you!

[Nanami?][Meowgula] Congratulations, wrong answer! I'm a Furball the same color as your sister's clothes! I'm not a dummy like the Inner Demon who'd go and use Restraint!
And the Ancestor from the Barrier Lake… definitely a fake!
Senior Na Ying… no, you're not the Senior!

[Na Ying?] Oh-ho-ho, seems there's been a little accident. Little girl, don't be hasty. Taking in so much knowledge at once is bound to cause a brief period of overactivity in your spirit-consciousness, even conjuring many illusions that don't exist.
Illusions? What, what are you saying…

[Na Ying?] Listen, little girl, cast aside those jumbled thoughts in your mind. I'll pass my insight on the Domain to you; it may shape the road ahead for you. In the future, you might even possess a Domain——
My… my Domain?

[Neko] Listen, geezer! I do possess a Domain—— and it's Domain Tier 3 Peak!
[Na Ying?] …(dissipates)
[Neko] Phew… this one's true form was the Inner Demon, which spared me a hard fight. I feel my understanding of it has deepened another layer. At this rate, I wonder if I can go a step further…
Pay respects to the Blazing Sun statue in the Illusory Realm · Battlefield

[Blazing Sun Projection]
Ahem… my little brother Bright Moon told me about you. Anyway, this statue is made of better material! Though it takes not just Knife Coins but some Cosmic Coins too… in return, you can receive the Blazing Sun's blessings! They're stronger than the original buffs!

Oh, and the life-force and pay-extra rules are the same as before.

Cultivators above Skyhigh-Tier Rank 4, forget it — this mid-grade statue can't hold too strong a power-projection.
Also, a reminder—— the blessing contents switch every 22.5h. Given the Skyhigh-Tier time flow of 4.8h/s, checking the blessing on the spot isn't recommended — consult a table instead.

[???] I won't accept it! I won't accept it! I, a genius, brilliant all my life, braved every hardship through the genius-battle, only to be undone by a mere trial mission!

[Neko] Such intense resentment, and from someone I've never seen before. Could it be… the master of this spaceship? That is, the alien visitor who fell here.

[Neko] During the time I was sealed inside the spaceship, his resentment had already lodged deep in my heart, and for so long I never even noticed…
[???] Kill, kill you all! Daring to block a genius's road to power — you're nothing but a pack of ignorant natives——
[Neko] Seems… you really can't accept it. Those Bloodfall Continent residents you call "natives," the ones who died at your hands — didn't they want to live too? Your wanton slaughter of low-tier Bloodfall residents plainly gained you nothing — it was merely a way to vent your resentment!

Do you think a true genius, facing his fall…
would grow hysterical like you?

[???] You… I…
Gaaaahhh——

The alien visitor suddenly fell silent, as if utterly calmed. His gaze became placid and still. Then, all at once, the resentment scattered around him began to boil, and the alien visitor let out a sinister laugh.

[???] Heh heh heh… when the reactor melted down, did you ever wonder why the radiation was so brief? It's all because of — me, the genius! I have already recovered to half a step from Skyhigh-Tier!
Use Legacy Crystal · Pink to draw! 10 for a single pull, 90 for a ten-pull!
Single pull (10 x Legacy Crystal · Pink)
Ten-pull (90 x Legacy Crystal · Pink)
Fifty-pull (450 x Legacy Crystal · Pink)
Convert the Heart of the Ice Field (requires the Heart of the Ice Field to be in the equipment slot)
Feng… Brother Feng.
[Feng] Koko. I'm surprised you could break through four layers of the illusion in a row to reach here. But this is where it ends.
Huh…?

[Feng] In fact, all these years, I've watched you break through in turn — the Ice Field, the Water Prison, the four layers of illusion. I've been watching your growth all along.

I even hid inside that gacha machine—— though without a one-in-a-trillion miracle, you'd never have found me.

Your performance has satisfied me greatly, so you have earned the right—— to become my soul-servant.
I… I don't understand.

[Feng] With this much said, you still don't get it? In truth, I noticed you very early — noticed a certain quality in you. I knew every plan of the Hundred Clans and the Thirteen Axes, so I used them to get close to you, and silently left a deep brand upon your heart.
A brand? All I remember is… 1.21Δ.

[Feng] …It's this late and you're STILL thinking about money?! Come, let go of your body and mind. I'll shelter you, make you a powerhouse, and you'll follow me across the vast worlds.

[Neko] And if I say no? You're lying—— in every sense. When Brother Feng traveled with me, I sneaked a look at his stat panel. You think with your level you could simulate the sheer pressure of Hundred-Line Style Golden Sky Law
4.489e20 1.672e18 8.649e17?
Isn't the fabricated excuse a bit too childish?

(Feng's figure changed into ???)
[???] What utter nonsense! You fabricate stats and don't even fabricate Agility?! This is an RPG plane!

[Shaxue] Huh? I unexpectedly remembered something I'd forgotten. I have you to thank for that.
[Neko] Even having met the City Lord and Senior Zuo'a, those two Domain-Tier masters, standing before them didn't feel as unfathomable as Feng did… so, after glimpsing the vision of a true powerhouse…
These words of yours alone won't shake me, you know.
[Lord of Inner Demons] You have earned the right to know my identity. I am—— the Lord of Inner Demons. The source of everything you fear in your heart, of all your negative emotions.
All that you fear? Why don't you take a look at your own skill bar?

[Lord of Inner Demons] You have earned the right to know my identity. I am—— the Lord of Inner Demons. The source of everything you fear in your heart, of all your negative emotions. Skills? Fine, take a look!

[Xiyue] Welcome to the deepest layer of the Illusory Realm Core—— Illusory Realm Core · Reality. Don't look around — you won't find me. I'm deep in your sea of consciousness, relaying messages through thought.
Miss Xiyue, why are you here?

[Neko] Also, what is this illusion really about? Senior Zuo'a, he——

[Xiyue] Here, stop calling that guy "Senior," pah. Right now he's trying to erase the soul-mark on you, too preoccupied to notice, which gave me the chance to slip in.
Huh?

[Xiyue] Let me keep it short—— well, it doesn't matter, thought-messaging is fast. It won't take up much of your time. First, remember the "ranking" in the Water Prison? Mm, I mean, that vacant first place.
Why bring this up all of a sudden?

[Neko] Intel says that from a few hundred years ago, the first spot has been kept vacant by Lanqi.

[Xiyue] Kukuku… of course it's vacant, because number one already left the Water Prison and defected to the barrier's master. "Defected," though it was really just lurking at Zuo'a's side — happening to be of some use to him, and so accepted by him—— and at the same time, learning a great deal of intel.
The ranking's former first place… was you?!

[Xiyue] Clever, clever! As expected, talking with a clever child is a joy. Little Lan is as clever as you, though sadly she doesn't like to talk. Back in the Water Prison, she… ah, I'm getting off track.
You mean 【Lanqi】?

[Neko] …When I left the Water Prison, she said some half-understandable things to me.

[Xiyue] Ah, I can pretty much guess what they were. The reason she didn't speak plainly wasn't that she didn't want to, but that she couldn't. The whole Water Prison was under 【Zuo'a's】 surveillance. In relaying any message, one slip and, if he grew suspicious, it could mean being wiped out!
Zuo'a — just what kind of person is he?

[Xiyue] He's a Domain-Tier powerhouse, and also, without a doubt, a… madman.

[Neko] Then, those precious inheritances… don't tell me?

[Xiyue] All a facade. It looks like he screens geniuses to receive inheritances, but in truth he only means to use it to reshape his own body, forging a "vessel" that can hold his soul! As far as I know, the powerhouses of the Water Prison, no matter how they left, in the end almost without exception became part of that vessel.
What——!

[Xiyue] To become a vessel, the minimum standard is… living life, high-rank Sky-Tier strength. If you have Domain Tier 3, you undoubtedly meet it too. The Water Prison's exit, once you meet the standard, summons the powerhouses out—— and then, as a matter of course, they become part of the vessel.
Then what about killing all the other powerhouses?

[Xiyue] That's just a pretense… life-and-death slaughter is forever the catalyst of the strong. In all history, no one has ever killed every powerhouse in the Water Prison. Because… outsiders who stumble into this realm are replenished in a nearly endless stream. The powerhouses' only ends are to be killed by another, to die of old age, or to become a vessel.
Life-and-death slaughter is forever the catalyst of the strong.

[Neko] "So long as one powerhouse is born among thousands of the weak, its value to the race far outweighs those thousands"… all right, I understand. When does your health bar light up? (red and blue light flickering in her eyes)

[Xiyue] Kukuku… a reaction like that, little girl — I've met too many madmen, I suppose. Pity Shaxue didn't top up my stats, so all I can do is give you all the intel I know!

Zuo'a, an utterly insignificant nobody. In the Hunyuan Sect, thick with talent, he — of plain aptitude — was ignored, ostracized by his fellow disciples, and endured no end of scorn. In this world full of competition and slaughter, the weak can only live at the very bottom. He strove desperately, but his cultivation talent was too poor to change anything. Until one day, he met a genius senior-brother of his. The two talked happily, and in their cheer drank a few cups too many. That drunken sleep, he never woke from again.

In everyone's eyes, he abandoned his ambitions, spending his days carousing with friends and drinking. In time, he even befriended a few influential people. He could finally hold his head up before his fellow disciples — but no one imagined this was only the first step of his grand plan. That day, the sect's elders found, in the Wildbeast Forest, the corpse of his senior-brother. Beside it lay several Sky-Tier Ferocious Beasts. He had clearly just been through a fierce battle, drenched in blood, his face smeared with dirt and dust.

After that, Zuo'a grew despondent, as if his senior-brother's death had affected him greatly. He no longer drank and reveled, but spent all his days immersed in the training hall. From then on, his cultivation began to climb steadily. Everyone thought the shock had suddenly awakened him, and looked at him with new respect. The sect-master, overjoyed, even named him junior sect-master on the spot — the future heir of the Hunyuan Sect!

[Xiyue] Mm. That's how it was. This should have been an inspiring story… but, little girl, did you spot the doubt?
The cause of that senior-brother's death — something's fishy about it——
[Xiyue] Correct! Later, the Hunyuan Sect's master also noticed something was wrong, and ordered a careful investigation into the matter——

After Zuo'a rose to high position, his temperament grew ever more unbridled, without concealment. As his virtue failed to match his station, more and more people came to hate him. Fire cannot be wrapped in paper—— the matter of the senior-brother's fall was raised again, and many disciples confronted Zuo'a, analyzing all the suspicious points. The sect-master was a Domain-Tier powerhouse; the facade that ordinary people couldn't see through was laid bare before his eyes, and clues were soon gathered one after another.

When the truth came out and everyone awoke to it — that the senior-brother had indeed been killed by Zuo'a, his innate Primordial-Spirit Body seized as well — it was too late. To their horror, everyone found that Zuo'a, abusing his authority as junior sect-master, had for years been cultivating within the sect's treasure—— the 【Palace of Time】. His cultivation had long since surpassed appearances by who knew how much! When the hypocritical mask was torn away, in little more than a hundred years, he had astonishingly reached Skyhigh-Tier Rank 9!

Zuo'a coldly swept his gaze over the crowd. Ruthless, he struck first. The sect-master tried to stop him, only to find the Zuo'a before him was merely an illusory body. His true self, under the guise of junior sect-master, had long since passed unhindered from one sect gate to the next, unleashing a one-sided massacre. He was Skyhigh-Tier Rank 9, and had seized an innate Primordial-Spirit Body; those Earth- and Sky-Tier disciples, even the Skyhigh-Tier sect elders, were utterly powerless before him!

In all the Hunyuan Sect, only the sect-master could fight him. And that sect-master, without a moment's hesitation, staked his own life in a desperate struggle with Zuo'a. Even so, the Hunyuan Sect's losses were extremely heavy. This scene, witnessed by the other sects, caused a great uproar. The sect-master died. Zuo'a's body was destroyed, but he broke through in the thick of battle, his soul escaping far away. The sect's treasure, the 【Palace of Time】, he took with him. Soon after, the Hunyuan Sect was carved up by many factions. The once-peerless, mightiest power……
……vanished thus into the long river of the Yangang Fief's history.

[Xiyue] The part that follows, you already know. No need to repeat it. That's how it was. The family of the Hunyuan Sect-master was originally a renowned house of the Yangang Fief. After that earth-shaking war, the Hunyuan Sect vanished, the family's power was gutted, and it fell into decline. That sect-master was a man worthy of respect; single-handedly, he spared the whole sect the fate of total extermination. He was also—— the ancestor of me, and of Lanqi.
Hearing someone describe their own heavy past so lightly really is hard to bear.

[Neko] Listening to another recount their own heavy burdens so casually.

[Xiyue] Ah, it's fine. I'm very happy right now, because I've seen hope—— the hope of rewriting this fate. Our family endured in silence for generation after generation, a full ten epochs, ceaselessly gathering intel all the while, tracing Zuo'a's whereabouts and all he'd done over the years.

[Xiyue] Lanqi and I, under such conditions, quietly disguised ourselves as ordinary adventurers, lurked at Zuo'a's side, and… bided our time to act! What Lanqi did in the Water Prison wasn't to protect her own position, but to protect the Water Prison's powerhouses — to keep them from growing stronger and reaching the standard to become a "vessel."

[Neko] Phew… what a winding story… you've been waiting?
Waiting for the power to turn the tide to appear?

[Xiyue] Yes. I know our plan is dangerous, even hopeless, you could say. Because the Zuo'a of now has nearly recovered his former state. This is the only chance to kill him; we can only stake everything on one throw. Even at the cost of sacrifice, we accept it. Lanqi and I—— our family has waited ten epochs, and we don't want to wait any longer.
I believe you.

[Neko] So Zuo'a hoarded that many treasures… that explains it. Wait, doesn't that mean Sister is in great danger!

[Xiyue] Mm-mm, don't worry. Isn't your sister tucked away in the chest? As long as we destroy this place before Zuo'a rummages through and drags her out, she'll be fine. I'll do all I can to protect your sister and get her out unharmed.
I'll give it my all too!

[Neko] Then, Miss Xiyue, a pleasure working together.

[Xiyue] …Thank you, I'm counting on you…
Then, help me open the ground of the final battle!
[Xiyue] Mm… ready!
Finally here, the wellspring of power sustaining the entire illusion…
[Zuo'a] Congratulations, little girl. To have made it here alive means you're qualified to receive my, 【Zuo'a's】, inheritance. Only——
No need for you to unveil the answer; I already know.

[Neko] You've spun so many lies — truly disappointing, Senior Zuo'a.

[Zuo'a] Ah-hahahaha, very good, interesting, interesting. It seems things have taken a slightly unexpected turn.
Your era has already passed, Senior.

[Neko] There's no need to keep stirring up trouble here.

[Zuo'a] Enough talk. My grand plan of a hundred thousand years is but one step from completion — how could I give it up over one little girl? You know how much I hate that undying old sect-master. If not for him, would a hero like me have languished in this barrier for a hundred thousand years?
After doing all this, you still haven't realized how utterly mediocre you are?

[Neko] Your path was wrong from the very start. Over a hundred thousand years, more than two hundred thirty thousand adventurers in all barged in here. Of them, the two hundred thousand who hadn't reached Sky-Tier became nourishment for the barrier the instant they stepped in. You didn't even think to loot the bodies—— if some of them carried a treasure like a B6 Laser Gun, you'd just leave it?
Thirty thousand Sky-Tiers, under the Water Prison's time acceleration,

[Neko] over five hundred thousand years and countless massacres, only a few hundred survive today. Considering a Sky-Tier's lifespan is merely ten thousand years… that several hundred still survive means the vast majority died of natural causes! The Water Prison's atmosphere should be one of mutual suspicion, not the order it has now!
Also, there were twenty-five Skyhigh-Tier powerhouses,

[Neko] who, already qualifying as vessels, were killed by you without mercy… is that your excuse for leaving their souls untended?

[Zuo'a] Little girl, I don't know where you got the nerve to start lecturing me on how badly I run my Water Prison. But your cultivation is still far too green for me.
[Zuo'a] Are you kidding?
[Neko] Time's up. Time to transform — power of the Domain.
(Warning ⚠️: after triggering this cutscene, quick-return will be disabled)

[Zuo'a] Is this all your trump card amounts to?
[Neko] It's a long way from over.

【The Act 3 BOSS battle has begun!】

Each time you defeat a 【Heart Spirit】, you gain 1 point of 【Soul Power】!
When Soul Power accumulates to 5 or 10 points, your Health Cap increases by 20%!
At 15 or 20 points, your Attack/Defense/Agility rise by 1e8!
At 25 points, the seal will be complete!
Once the seal is complete, Zuo'a's strength will be weakened 10081-fold, and enter the final showdown with Neko!

Soul Crystal Ingot represents 【Soul Power】!
Heart Spirit represents the remaining count of each such Heart Spirit on the field!

Once the final showdown begins, there's no turning back!
Load your save… I think I warned you about this outside. Of course, once you've finished, you can still go back.
(The residual water-element barrier still flows through the Water Prison,)

but that faint, suffocating pressure has already dispersed.
A dozen-odd figures stand encircling the platform where the sky-light spills down.

[Neko] Huh, huh? So everyone here is from Miss Xiyue's… family?

[Bing Xiyue] "Xiyue" was only a temporary name. Let me reintroduce myself. I am, of the Ice Clan, Bing Xiyue.
Then… what about the others?

[Bing Xiyue] Hehe, sorry for only telling you now. But it couldn't be helped. Also, of these twenty on the ranking — not all, but most — were arranged into place by us over time, lurking like deathsworn.
I see, no wonder…

[Nanami] So many powerhouses with Domains gathered here.

[Bing Xiyue] Mm, in fact that's not all. To obtain the Water Prison's information, our family paid the price of several Skyhigh-Tier seniors' lives, one after another.
So, was all this within your calculations?

[Nanami] Then, then Koko and I——

Nanami's emotions suddenly ran high; though Neko ultimately broke the deadlock, she'd never wanted her little sister dragged into something like this.

[Neko] Sister, it's all right. After going through all this, I feel terrifyingly strong now. Once we're home, it's time to have a talk with the old man too… the head-of-house seat, since ancient times, goes to the able!
Mm, are you leaving?…

[Nanami] There's still much I'd like to ask, but what you all carry is heavier than I imagined. Go rest well.

[Moore] Let's go; the family's seniors have long been waiting anxiously. Then, we part here. Take care.
Sister… what you said just now,

[Neko] you saw something in the illusion you'd never seen before — is that true?

[Nanami] Yes, that scene… it really was strange. Koko, you said the illusions you passed through generate, from your memories, things that run counter to your convictions, trying to plunge you into darkness. But I don't remember such things in my memory—— or ever having been to the place in that illusion. A sky of interweaving golden radiance, colossal beasts surging and dancing among the clouds, celestial music echoing to the heavens.
Wow, that sounds pretty magical…
[Nanami] But… whenever I try to make out those beast-shapes, to hear that celestial music clearly, my consciousness seems to be jolted into dizziness.
Each person's illusion is different… is that it?

[Neko] So Sister, do you have any leads?

[Nanami] I don't know, but after getting home I want to go into secluded cultivation for a while first. Bizarre as it was, when I walked out I felt my insights had multiplied. As if that place hides some chance for a breakthrough.
That's wonderful, Sister — let's hurry back,

[Neko] and tell Brother Feng and Father the news…

[Nanami] Whew—— all right, our business here is done; time to leave.
[Nabu] Koko! Nana! Are you all right? I've been searching all over for you—
I'm fine.

[Neko] Father, you said it yourself — only dangerous places hold opportunity. The strength I have now is precisely thanks to this string of life-and-death crises.

[Nabu] Sky-Tier Peak? Domain Tier 4?!! That's my daughter for you… Speak — what brings you home this time?
I hear… there's been a Yangang Fief Hunting Tournament lately?

[Nabu] That's right… anyone below Skyhigh-Tier can enter. After the Beast Tide in year 1372 of epoch 31698, all the Wildbeasts of the Yangang Fief rose a tier. The Hunting Tournament's rewards are considerable, and Skyhigh-Tier Wildbeast materials may be brought home.
I see! Then I'm going!

[Nabu] Koko can, but Nana had better not… By the way, I'd meant to pass the Na Family treasure 【Eve】 to you two. But because I searched all across the Yangang Fief for so long, I too gained insight, and one day broke into Skyhigh-Tier. Looks like this head-of-house seat, I'll have to keep for a few more years!
I object!
[Nabu] It's good for the young to have spirit. If Koko has the strength to defeat me, then I can retire and enjoy my old age with peace of mind.
Is this good enough now?

[Nabu] Good, good, good. Here's what you asked for. Heh, you've grown up…

[Reminder] Obtained the Na Family treasure 【Eve】!
The Family System is now active!
What method can fuse the Intermediate Evolution Crystal

[Feng Xinghong] Within this ancient tomb roam many undead creatures, as you're surely aware. They can't condense energy cores within their bodies, so they refine energy very slowly. If you can find a Skyhigh-Tier Rank 3 +, indiscriminately ravenous undead creature and feed it 10 Intermediate Evolution Crystal Fragments, there's hope of slaying it on the spot while its aura is unstable after breaking through, and extracting the roughly-refined Intermediate Evolution Crystal.
What kind of undead creature is suitable to hunt?

[Feng Xinghong] Even having just broken through to Skyhigh-Tier Rank 4 with an unstable aura, the target still has at least near-Skyhigh-Tier Rank 3 + strength. Fortunately, an ancient-tomb undead's strength largely depends on its stored refined-blood. Agile dog-type undead are probably best, because they're very fragile — just find a way to whittle down their health and you can easily kill up-realm.
You explain so much — why don't you help me fight it?

[Feng Xinghong] The Yangang Fief Hunting Tournament has an age limit. For an ancient like me from three epochs ago, sneaking in was no easy feat. If I lent a hand, I'd likely be escorted back to the city by the Lord's Manor in an instant. So all I can do is lay out the "bait" for you…
(provides 10 Intermediate Evolution Crystal Fragments)
City Lord…? Why are you here?

[Neko] This… shouldn't this be the Hunting Tournament's finish line?
